blueprints.description: Items, locations, movements and suppliers for a warehouse: a dashboard, item lists and cards, item pages, a location tree, stock adjustment and check in and out.

screens.name: inventory.dashboard
screens.title: Dashboard
screens.description: Low stock, stock value, top movers and recent movements.

screens.name: inventory.items
screens.title: Items
screens.description: Every item with its stock, low stock highlighted.

screens.name: inventory.items.gallery
screens.title: Item gallery
screens.description: Every item as a card with its picture.

screens.name: inventory.items.record
screens.title: Item
screens.description: One item with its stock by location, movement history and supplier.

screens.name: inventory.locations
screens.title: Locations
screens.description: The location tree beside what is stored in the chosen location.

screens.name: inventory.movements
screens.title: Movements
screens.description: Every check in, check out, transfer and adjustment.

screens.name: inventory.movements.check
screens.title: Check in or out
screens.description: Scan or search an item and check it in or out, from a phone.

screens.name: inventory.suppliers
screens.title: Suppliers
screens.description: The suppliers items are bought from.

templates.name: InventoryDashboard
templates.description: Low stock count, stock value, top movers, recent movements and the items to reorder.

templates.name: InventoryItemList
templates.description: Items with sku, category, location, quantity and status, low stock highlighted, filtered by category, location and status.

templates.name: InventoryItemGallery
templates.description: Items as cards with a picture, sku, quantity and status, low stock highlighted.

templates.name: InventoryItemPage
templates.description: One item: key facts, its fields and supplier, its stock by location and its movement history.

templates.name: InventoryLocations
templates.description: The tree of locations beside what is stored in the chosen location.

templates.name: InventoryMovementList
templates.description: Check ins, check outs, transfers and adjustments with the item, quantity, location and who did it.

templates.name: InventoryCheckInOut
templates.description: A mobile-first form to scan or search for an item and check it in or out, with who has it and when it is due back.

templates.name: InventorySupplierList
templates.description: Suppliers with their contact, the items they supply and their status.

templates.name: InventoryAdjustStock
templates.description: A short form that adjusts the stock of one item without leaving the page.

templates.name: InventoryQuickCreateItem
templates.description: A short form that creates one item without leaving the page.

templates.name: InventoryQuickCreateSupplier
templates.description: A short form that creates one supplier without leaving the page.
